relays.name: Lunar Pathfinder
relays.operator: ESA, built and operated by Surrey Satellite Technology Ltd
relays.launch_note: To fly on Firefly's Blue Ghost Mission 2, integrated into its Elytra Dark orbital vehicle. ESA: launch not earlier than November 2026; SSTL: due to launch 2027.
relays.orbit_note: An indicative elliptical lunar frozen orbit favouring the Southern Lunar Hemisphere. Heights use ESA's slides; SSTL Service Guide V004 supplies baseline RAAN 0 deg and argument of pericenter 86.322 deg, without a frame or epoch. Operational node and phase are not established, so both are swept. The conflicting published inclinations remain a sensitivity range.

relays.name: Altus-1 data-relay satellite
relays.launch_note: Planned to fly alongside IM-3 (NASA, August 2026).
relays.orbit_note: NASA says only that Altus-1 is deployed 'in lunar orbit'. The orbit used here is assumed from NASA's reference design; where its node and its place along the orbit will be is swept.

relays.name: IM-4 data-relay satellite, first of two
relays.launch_note: One of two lunar data relay satellites expected to launch with IM-4, currently scheduled for 2027 (Intuitive Machines, April 2025).
relays.orbit_note: Intuitive Machines' release gives no orbit for these satellites.
